caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a border of red fringe on three sides and a plain edge on the upper left side. The textile is composed of a background filled with fine, dark horizontal lines, and is decorated with various red patterns and motifs. These motifs include large floral designs, symmetrical geometric figures, and lattice patterns distributed across the textile, divided into rectangular and square sections by straight vertical and horizontal lines. In the lower right section, inside a bordered square, there is a block of text that reads: “MADE BY C. WIZARD ALLEN TOWN 1841.” The red areas are solid, while the background appears to be a lighter, neutral color with fine cross-hatching. The red fringe at the bottom and right consists of numerous individual threads extending outward. The textile design fills most of the surface, except for a thin margin along the top and left edges.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
